      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2
- Perspective-diverse verify: when a finding can fail in more than one way, give each verifier a distinct lens (correctness, security, perf, does-it-reproduce) instead of N identical refuters — diversity catches failure modes redundancy can't.
- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

Scale to what the user asked for. "find any bugs" → a few finders, single-vote verify. "thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

These patterns aren't exhaustive — compose novel harnesses when the task calls for it (tournament brackets, self-repair loops, staged escalation, whatever fits).

Use this tool for multi-step orchestration where control flow should be deterministic (loops, conditionals, fan-out) rather than model-driven.

## Resume

The tool result includes a runId. To resume after a pause, kill, or script edit, relaunch with Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}) — the longest unchanged prefix of agent() calls returns cached results instantly; the first edited/new call and everything after it runs live. Same script + same args → 100% cache hit. Before diagnosing why a completed workflow returned an empty or unexpected result, Read <transcriptDir>/journal.jsonl — it records each agent's actual return value; do not assume cached results are non-empty. Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() are unavailable in scripts (they would break this) — stamp results after the workflow returns, or pass timestamps via args. Fallback when no journal is available: Read agent-<id>.jsonl files in the transcript directory and hand-author a continuation script.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

1	"""Standard library HTTP API for flowd."""
2	
3	import json
4	import re
5	from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
6	from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse
7	
8	from .model import WorkflowError
9	from .scheduler import ConflictError, LeaseError
10	
11	MAX_BODY = 1 << 20
12	STATUS_FOR_CODE = {"unknown_run": 404, "unknown_workflow": 404, "unknown_step": 404,
13	                   "cross_tenant": 403}
14	DECISIONS = ("approve", "reject")
15	
16	
17	class _Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
18	    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
19	    server_version = "flowd/0.1"
20	
21	    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # keep the console quiet
22	        pass
23	
24	    # -- plumbing ------------------------------------------------------
25	    def _send(self, code, raw=b""):
26	        self.send_response(code)
27	        if code != 204:
28	            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
29	        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
30	        self.end_headers()
31	        if raw:
32	            self.wfile.write(raw)
33	
34	    def _json(self, code, payload):
35	        self._send(code, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8"))
36	
37	    def _error(self, code, message):
38	        self._json(code, {"error": message})
39	
40	    def _body(self):
41	        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
42	        if length <= 0:
43	            return {}
44	        if length > MAX_BODY:
45	            raise WorkflowError("request body too large", "body_too_large")
46	        try:
47	            payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
48	        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
49	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be valid JSON", "bad_json")
50	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
51	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be a JSON object", "bad_json")
52	        return payload
53	
54	    def _tenant(self, query, body=None):
55	        tenant = (body or {}).get("tenant") or (query.get("tenant") or [None])[0]
56	        if not tenant:
57	            raise WorkflowError("tenant is required", "bad_tenant")
58	        return tenant
59	    # -- verbs ---------------------------------------------------------
60	    def do_GET(self):
61	        self._dispatch("GET")
62	
63	    def do_POST(self):
64	        self._dispatch("POST")
65	
66	    def _dispatch(self, method):
67	        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
68	        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/") or "/"
69	        try:
70	            self._route(method, path, parse_qs(parsed.query))
71	        except LeaseError as exc:
72	            self._error(409, exc.message)
73	        except ConflictError as exc:
74	            self._error(409, exc.message)
75	        except WorkflowError as exc:
76	            self._error(STATUS_FOR_CODE.get(exc.code, 400), exc.message)
77	        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
78	            self._error(500, "internal error: %s" % exc)
79	
80	    def _route(self, method, path, query):
81	        body = {}
82	        if method == "GET":
83	            if path == "/healthz":
84	                return self._json(200, {"ok": True})
85	            if path == "/v1/runs":
86	                return self._list_runs(query)
87	        elif method == "POST":
88	            if path == "/v1/workflows":
89	                body = self._body()
90	                tenant = self._tenant({}, body)
91	                plan = self.scheduler.submit(tenant, body.get("workflow_id"), body.get("steps"))
92	                return self._json(201, dict(plan, tenant=tenant))
93	            if path == "/v1/runs":
94	                body = self._body()
95	                run = self.scheduler.start_run(self._tenant({}, body), body.get("workflow_id"),
96	                                               body.get("run_id"), body.get("params"),
97	                                               body.get("max_parallelism"),
98	                                               body.get("idempotency_key"),
99	                                               body.get("not_before"))
100	                return self._json(201, _run_view(run))
101	            action = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)/(claim|complete|fail|decision|heartbeat)", path)
102	            if action:
103	                if action.group(2) == "decision":
104	                    return self._decision(action.group(1), self._body())
105	                if action.group(2) == "heartbeat":
106	                    return self._heartbeat(action.group(1), self._body())
107	                return self._step_action(action.group(1), action.group(2), self._body())
108	        solo = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)", path)
109	        if method == "GET" and solo:
110	            return self._get_run(query, solo.group(1))
111	        return self._error(404, "no route for %s %s" % (method, path))
112	
113	    # -- handlers ------------------------------------------------------
114	    def _get_run(self, query, run_id):
115	        tenant = self._tenant(query)
116	        owner = self.scheduler.store.run_exists(run_id)
117	        if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
118	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
119	        return self._json(200, _run_view(self.scheduler.get_run(tenant, run_id)))
120	
121	    def _list_runs(self, query):
122	        tenant = self._tenant(query)
123	        items, next_after = self.scheduler.list_runs(
124	            tenant,
125	            status=(query.get("status") or [None])[0],
126	            limit=int((query.get("limit") or ["50"])[0]),
127	            after=(query.get("after") or [None])[0],
128	        )
129	        return self._json(200, {"tenant": tenant, "items": [_run_view(r) for r in items],
130	                                "next_after": next_after})
131	
132	    def _step_action(self, run_id, action, body):
133	        tenant, worker_id = self._tenant({}, body), body.get("worker_id")
134	        if action == "claim":
135	            step = self.scheduler.claim(tenant, run_id, worker_id, body.get("lease_seconds", 30))
136	            return self._send(204) if step is None else self._json(200, {"step": _step_view(step)})
137	        if action == "complete":
138	            run = self.scheduler.complete(tenant, run_id, body.get("step_id"), worker_id,
139	                                          body.get("result"))
140	        else:
141	            run = self.scheduler.fail(tenant, run_id, body.get("step_id"), worker_id,
142	                                      body.get("error"))
143	        return self._json(200, _run_view(run))
144	
145	    def _heartbeat(self, run_id, body):
146	        """Renew a lease; strict field validation, anything bad is a 400."""
147	        for name in ("tenant", "step_id", "worker_id"):
148	            value = body.get(name)
149	            if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
150	                raise WorkflowError("%s must be a non-empty string" % name, "bad_%s" % name)
151	        run = self.scheduler.heartbeat(body["tenant"], run_id, body["step_id"],
152	                                       body["worker_id"], body.get("lease_seconds", 30))
153	        return self._json(200, _run_view(run))
154	
155	    def _decision(self, run_id, body):
156	        """Validate strictly; any missing/blank/wrong-type field is a 400."""
157	        fields = {}
158	        for name in ("tenant", "step_id", "actor"):
159	            value = body.get(name)
160	            if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
161	                raise WorkflowError("%s must be a non-empty string" % name, "bad_%s" % name)
162	            fields[name] = value.strip()
163	        decision = body.get("decision")
164	        if decision not in DECISIONS:
165	            raise WorkflowError("decision must be one of %s" % ", ".join(DECISIONS),
166	                                "bad_decision")
167	        tenant = fields["tenant"]
168	        owner = self.scheduler.store.run_exists(run_id)
169	        if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
170	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
171	        run = self.scheduler.decide(tenant, run_id, fields["step_id"], fields["actor"], decision)
172	        return self._json(200, _run_view(run))
173	
174	
175	def _step_view(step):
176	    return {"id": step["id"], "kind": step.get("kind", "task"), "status": step["status"],
177	            "attempt": step["attempt"],
178	            "max_attempts": step["max_attempts"], "depends_on": list(step["depends_on"]),
179	            "worker_id": step["worker_id"], "lease_deadline": step["lease_deadline"],
180	            "next_attempt_at": step["next_attempt_at"], "result": step.get("result"),
181	            "error": step.get("error"), "approval": step.get("approval")}
182	
183	
184	def _run_view(run):
185	    return {"tenant": run["tenant"], "run_id": run["run_id"], "workflow_id": run["workflow_id"],
186	            "status": run["status"], "params": run.get("params") or {},
187	            "max_parallelism": run.get("max_parallelism"),
188	            "idempotency_key": run.get("idempotency_key"),
189	            "not_before": run.get("not_before"),
190	            "created_at": run.get("created_at"), "updated_at": run.get("updated_at"),
191	            "steps": [_step_view(run["steps"][sid]) for sid in run["step_order"]],
192	            "history_length": len(run.get("history") or [])}
193	
194	
195	def create_server(store, host="127.0.0.1", port=8080, scheduler=None):
196	    """Build (but do not start) a ThreadingHTTPServer bound to ``host:port``."""
197	    if scheduler is None:
198	        from .scheduler import Scheduler
199	
200	        scheduler = Scheduler(store)
201	    return ThreadingHTTPServer((host, int(port)),
202	                               type("FlowdHandler", (_Handler,), {"scheduler": scheduler}))

1	"""Persistence for flowd: workflows, runs, tenants and append-only history.
2	
3	Layout::
4	
5	    <root>/<tenant>/workflows.json
6	    <root>/<tenant>/idempotency.json
7	    <root>/<tenant>/runs/<run_id>.json
8	
9	Every write is atomic (temp file + ``os.replace``) so a crash cannot leave a
10	half written run behind, and a fresh store over the same root sees exactly
11	the same workflows and runs.
12	"""
13	
14	import json
15	import os
16	import threading
17	import time as _time
18	import uuid
19	from contextlib import contextmanager
20	
21	from .model import KIND_TASK, WorkflowError, format_time, plan_workflow
22	
23	RUN_PENDING = "pending"
24	RUN_RUNNING = "running"
25	RUN_SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
26	RUN_FAILED = "failed"
27	
28	STEP_PENDING = "pending"
29	STEP_READY = "ready"
30	STEP_RUNNING = "running"
31	STEP_WAITING = "waiting"
32	STEP_SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
33	STEP_FAILED = "failed"
34	
35	TERMINAL_RUN_STATES = (RUN_SUCCEEDED, RUN_FAILED)
36	
37	
38	def atomic_write_json(path, payload):
39	    """Write ``payload`` as JSON to ``path`` atomically."""
40	    directory = os.path.dirname(path)
41	    if directory:
42	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
43	    tmp = "%s.tmp.%d" % (path, os.getpid())
44	    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
45	        json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
46	        handle.flush()
47	        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
48	    os.replace(tmp, path)
49	
50	
51	def read_json(path, default=None):
52	    try:
53	        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
54	            return json.load(handle)
55	    except FileNotFoundError:
56	        return default
57	
58	
59	class WorkflowStore:
60	    """Filesystem backed store for one data directory (all tenants)."""
61	
62	    def __init__(self, root, clock=None):
63	        self.root = os.path.abspath(root)
64	        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else _time.time
65	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
66	        os.makedirs(self.root, exist_ok=True)
67	
68	    def now(self):
69	        return float(self._clock())
70	
71	    def now_iso(self):
72	        return format_time(self.now())
73	
74	    @contextmanager
75	    def locked(self):
76	        with self._lock:
77	            yield
78	
79	    # -- paths ---------------------------------------------------------
80	    def tenant_dir(self, tenant):
81	        if not isinstance(tenant, str) or not tenant.strip():
82	            raise WorkflowError("tenant must be a non-empty string", "bad_tenant")
83	        return os.path.join(self.root, tenant.strip())
84	
85	    def workflows_path(self, tenant):
86	        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "workflows.json")
87	
88	    def idempotency_path(self, tenant):
89	        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "idempotency.json")
90	
91	    def run_path(self, tenant, run_id):
92	        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs", "%s.json" % run_id)
93	
94	    def generate_run_id(self):
95	        return "run-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
96	
97	    # -- workflows -----------------------------------------------------
98	    def save_workflow(self, tenant, workflow_id, steps):
99	        plan = plan_workflow(workflow_id, steps)
100	        with self._lock:
101	            data = self.load_workflows(tenant)
102	            data[plan["workflow_id"]] = plan
103	            atomic_write_json(self.workflows_path(tenant), data)
104	        return plan
105	
106	    def load_workflows(self, tenant):
107	        return read_json(self.workflows_path(tenant), {}) or {}
108	
109	    def get_workflow(self, tenant, workflow_id):
110	        plan = self.load_workflows(tenant).get(workflow_id)
111	        if plan is None:
112	            raise WorkflowError("unknown workflow: %s" % workflow_id, "unknown_workflow")
113	        return plan
114	
115	    # -- idempotency index --------------------------------------------
116	    def load_idempotency(self, tenant):
117	        """Return the tenant's ``{trimmed key: {"run_id": ...}}`` map."""
118	        return read_json(self.idempotency_path(tenant), {}) or {}
119	
120	    def save_idempotency(self, tenant, index):
121	        atomic_write_json(self.idempotency_path(tenant), index)
122	        return index
123	
124	    # -- runs ----------------------------------------------------------
125	    def save_run(self, run):
126	        atomic_write_json(self.run_path(run["tenant"], run["run_id"]), run)
127	        return run
128	
129	    def load_run(self, tenant, run_id):
130	        run = read_json(self.run_path(tenant, run_id), None)
131	        if run is None:
132	            raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
133	        return normalize_run(run)
134	
135	    def run_exists(self, run_id):
136	        """Return the tenant owning ``run_id``, or ``None``."""
137	        for tenant in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
138	            if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(self.root, tenant, "runs", "%s.json" % run_id)):
139	                return tenant
140	        return None
141	
142	    def list_runs(self, tenant, status=None, limit=50, after=None):
143	        runs_dir = os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs")
144	        items = []
145	        for name in sorted(os.listdir(runs_dir)) if os.path.isdir(runs_dir) else []:
146	            run = read_json(os.path.join(runs_dir, name), None) if name.endswith(".json") else None
147	            if run is not None:
148	                items.append(normalize_run(run))
149	        items.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("created_at", ""), r.get("run_id", "")))
150	        if status:
151	            items = [r for r in items if r.get("status") == status]
152	        if after:
153	            position = [i for i, r in enumerate(items) if r.get("run_id") == after]
154	            items = items[position[0] + 1:] if position else []
155	        limit = max(1, int(limit))
156	        page = items[:limit]
157	        return page, (page[-1]["run_id"] if len(items) > limit else None)
158	
159	
160	def normalize_run(run):
161	    """Backfill fields missing from documents written by older versions.
162	
163	    Steps without ``kind`` predate approval nodes and are ordinary tasks.
164	    Runs without ``max_parallelism`` predate per-run concurrency quotas and
165	    have no limit (``None``).  Runs without ``idempotency_key`` predate
166	    tenant-scoped idempotency keys and never participate in dedup (``None``).
167	    Runs without ``not_before`` predate delayed start and begin immediately
168	    (``None``).  Mutates and returns ``run``.
169	    """
170	    run.setdefault("max_parallelism", None)
171	    run.setdefault("idempotency_key", None)
172	    run.setdefault("not_before", None)
173	    for step in run.get("steps", {}).values():
174	        step.setdefault("kind", KIND_TASK)
175	        step.setdefault("approval", None)
176	    return run
177	
178	
179	def new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, now_iso, max_parallelism=None,
180	            idempotency_key=None, not_before=None):
181	    """Build a fresh run document from a validated plan."""
182	    steps = {
183	        step["id"]: {
184	            "id": step["id"],
185	            "kind": step.get("kind", KIND_TASK),
186	            "depends_on": list(step["depends_on"]),
187	            "max_attempts": step["max_attempts"],
188	            "status": STEP_PENDING,
189	            "attempt": 0,
190	            "worker_id": None,
191	            "lease_deadline": None,
192	            "next_attempt_at": None,
193	            "ready_at": None,
194	            "started_at": None,
195	            "finished_at": None,
196	            "result": None,
197	            "error": None,
198	            "approval": None,
199	        }
200	        for step in plan["steps"]
201	    }
202	    return {
203	        "tenant": tenant,
204	        "workflow_id": workflow_id,
205	        "run_id": run_id,
206	        "status": RUN_PENDING,
207	        "params": params or {},
208	        "max_parallelism": max_parallelism,
209	        "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
210	        "not_before": not_before,
211	        "created_at": now_iso,
212	        "updated_at": now_iso,
213	        "step_order": list(plan["order"]),
214	        "order_index": {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(plan["order"])},
215	        "steps": steps,
216	        "history": [],
217	    }

1	"""DAG definition, validation and shared helpers for flowd.
2	
3	A workflow is a named DAG of steps; every step is a mapping::
4	
5	    {"id": "build", "depends_on": ["fetch"], "max_attempts": 3}
6	
7	Validation rejects duplicate ids, empty ids, unknown dependencies,
8	self/cyclic dependencies and bad ``max_attempts`` values.  A validated plan
9	is returned topologically sorted (ties broken by step id) so scheduling
10	order is deterministic.
11	"""
12	
13	import heapq
14	import time as _time
15	
16	STEP_STATES = ("pending", "ready", "running", "waiting", "succeeded", "failed")
17	RUN_STATES = ("pending", "running", "succeeded", "failed")
18	DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
19	
20	KIND_TASK = "task"
21	KIND_APPROVAL = "approval"
22	STEP_KINDS = (KIND_TASK, KIND_APPROVAL)
23	
24	
25	class WorkflowError(Exception):
26	    """Raised for any rejected workflow definition or illegal call."""
27	
28	    def __init__(self, message, code="invalid_workflow"):
29	        super().__init__(message)
30	        self.code = code
31	        self.message = message
32

34	def format_time(seconds):
35	    """Render epoch ``seconds`` as a sortable UTC ISO-8601 timestamp."""
36	    whole = int(seconds)
37	    micros = int(round((seconds - whole) * 1000000))
38	    if micros >= 1000000:
39	        whole, micros = whole + 1, micros - 1000000
40	    return "%s.%06dZ" % (_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", _time.gmtime(whole)), micros)
41	
42	
43	def validate_step(raw, index, seen_ids):
44	    """Validate one step definition and return its normalized form."""
45	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
46	        raise WorkflowError("step %d must be an object" % index)
47	    step_id = raw.get("id")
48	    if not isinstance(step_id, str):
49	        raise WorkflowError("step %d is missing a string id" % index)
50	    step_id = step_id.strip()
51	    if not step_id:
52	        raise WorkflowError("step %d has an empty id" % index)
53	    if step_id in seen_ids:
54	        raise WorkflowError("duplicate step id: %s" % step_id, "duplicate_step")
55	    seen_ids.add(step_id)
56	    depends_on = raw.get("depends_on") or []
57	    if not isinstance(depends_on, list):
58	        raise WorkflowError("step %s: depends_on must be a list" % step_id)
59	    for dep in depends_on:
60	        if not isinstance(dep, str) or not dep.strip():
61	            raise WorkflowError("step %s: depends_on entries must be non-empty strings" % step_id)
62	    depends_on = [d.strip() for d in depends_on]
63	    if len(set(depends_on)) != len(depends_on):
64	        raise WorkflowError("step %s: duplicate dependencies" % step_id)
65	    if step_id in depends_on:
66	        raise WorkflowError("step %s depends on itself" % step_id, "self_dependency")
67	    max_attempts = raw.get("max_attempts")
68	    if max_attempts is None:
69	        max_attempts = DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS
70	    if isinstance(max_attempts, bool) or not isinstance(max_attempts, int):
71	        raise WorkflowError("step %s: max_attempts must be an integer" % step_id, "bad_max_attempts")
72	    if max_attempts < 1:
73	        raise WorkflowError("step %s: max_attempts must be >= 1" % step_id, "bad_max_attempts")
74	    kind = raw.get("kind")
75	    if kind is None:
76	        kind = KIND_TASK
77	    if not isinstance(kind, str) or kind not in STEP_KINDS:
78	        raise WorkflowError(
79	            "step %s: kind must be one of %s" % (step_id, ", ".join(STEP_KINDS)), "bad_kind"
80	        )
81	    return {"id": step_id, "depends_on": depends_on, "max_attempts": max_attempts, "kind": kind}
82	
83	
84	def topo_order(steps):
85	    """Return step ids in dependency order using Kahn's algorithm."""
86	    ids = [s["id"] for s in steps]
87	    children = {sid: [] for sid in ids}
88	    indegree = {}
89	    for step in steps:
90	        for dep in step["depends_on"]:
91	            children[dep].append(step["id"])
92	        indegree[step["id"]] = len(step["depends_on"])
93	    heap = [(sid, sid) for sid in ids if indegree[sid] == 0]
94	    heapq.heapify(heap)
95	    order = []
96	    while heap:
97	        _, sid = heapq.heappop(heap)
98	        order.append(sid)
99	        for child in sorted(children[sid]):
100	            indegree[child] -= 1
101	            if indegree[child] == 0:
102	                heapq.heappush(heap, (child, child))
103	    if len(order) != len(ids):
104	        raise WorkflowError(
105	            "cyclic dependency involving: %s" % ", ".join(sorted(set(ids) - set(order))), "cycle"
106	        )
107	    return order
108	
109	
110	def plan_workflow(workflow_id, steps):
111	    """Validate ``steps`` and return a normalized, topologically sorted plan."""
112	    if not isinstance(workflow_id, str) or not workflow_id.strip():
113	        raise WorkflowError("workflow_id must be a non-empty string")
114	    if not isinstance(steps, list) or not steps:
115	        raise WorkflowError("steps must be a non-empty list")
116	    seen = set()
117	    normalized = [validate_step(raw, i, seen) for i, raw in enumerate(steps)]
118	    for step in normalized:
119	        for dep in step["depends_on"]:
120	            if dep not in seen:
121	                raise WorkflowError(
122	                    "step %s depends on unknown step: %s" % (step["id"], dep), "unknown_dependency"
123	                )
124	    order = topo_order(normalized)
125	    index = {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(order)}
126	    return {
127	        "workflow_id": workflow_id.strip(),
128	        "steps": sorted(normalized, key=lambda s: index[s["id"]]),
129	        "order": order,
130	    }

2	
3	All state transitions funnel through :class:`Scheduler` so the append-only
4	history stays the single source of truth.  ``replay`` rebuilds current state
5	from that history and must agree with the stored document.
6	"""

42	def backoff_seconds(attempt, base=1.0):
43	    """Exponential backoff: ``base * 2 ** (attempt - 1)``."""
44	    return float(base) * (2 ** (max(1, int(attempt)) - 1))

47	def normalize_max_parallelism(value):
48	    """Validate an optional per-run concurrency quota.
49	
50	    ``None`` means unlimited; only positive integers are accepted (booleans,
51	    floats, strings and non-positive integers are rejected).
52	    """
53	    if value is None:
54	        return None
55	    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
56	        raise WorkflowError(
57	            "max_parallelism must be a positive integer or null", "bad_max_parallelism"
58	        )
59	    return int(value)
60	
61	
62	def normalize_idempotency_key(value):
63	    """Validate an optional idempotency key.
64	
65	    ``None`` means idempotency is disabled and the call keeps its legacy
66	    behavior.  Otherwise the value must be a string that is non-empty after
67	    trimming; the trimmed key is what gets stored and matched.
68	    """
69	    if value is None:
70	        return None
71	    if not isinstance(value, str):
72	        raise WorkflowError("idempotency_key must be a string", "bad_idempotency_key")
73	    key = value.strip()
74	    if not key:
75	        raise WorkflowError("idempotency_key must be a non-empty string", "bad_idempotency_key")
76	    return key
77	
78	
79	def normalize_params(value):
80	    """Validate ``params`` on a keyed create: object only, null/omit = ``{}``."""
81	    if value is None:
82	        return {}
83	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
84	        raise WorkflowError("params must be a JSON object", "bad_params")
85	    return value
86

88	def normalize_not_before(value):
89	    """Validate an optional delayed-start time in UTC Unix seconds.
90	
91	    ``None`` (omitted or explicit ``null``) means start immediately.
92	    Otherwise the value must be a finite, non-negative int or float
93	    (booleans, strings, NaN and infinities are rejected).
94	    """
95	    if value is None:
96	        return None
97	    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
98	        raise WorkflowError(
99	            "not_before must be a finite non-negative number of Unix seconds or null",
100	            "bad_not_before",
101	        )
102	    try:
103	        seconds = float(value)
104	    except OverflowError:
105	        seconds = float("inf")
106	    if not math.isfinite(seconds) or seconds < 0:
107	        raise WorkflowError(
108	            "not_before must be a finite non-negative number of Unix seconds or null",
109	            "bad_not_before",
110	        )
111	    return seconds
112	
113	
114	def params_equal(left, right):
115	    """Semantic JSON equality for run params.
116	
117	    Object key order is ignored, array order is preserved, booleans are not
118	    numbers (``True != 1``), and numeric ints/floats compare by numeric value
119	    (``1 == 1.0``).
120	    """
121	    if isinstance(left, bool) or isinstance(right, bool):
122	        return isinstance(left, bool) and isinstance(right, bool) and left == right
123	    if isinstance(left, dict) or isinstance(right, dict):
124	        if not (isinstance(left, dict) and isinstance(right, dict)):
125	            return False
126	        if left.keys() != right.keys():
127	            return False
128	        return all(params_equal(left[name], right[name]) for name in left)
129	    if isinstance(left, list) or isinstance(right, list):
130	        if not (isinstance(left, list) and isinstance(right, list)):
131	            return False
132	        return len(left) == len(right) and all(
133	            params_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right)
134	        )
135	    if isinstance(left, (int, float)) and isinstance(right, (int, float)):
136	        return left == right
137	    return left == right

140	def _active_lease_count(run, now):
141	    """Count ordinary tasks in this run holding a strictly unexpired lease.
142	
143	    Approval nodes and tasks that are ready, waiting, succeeded, failed or
144	    pending retry do not count; a deadline equal to ``now`` is expired.
145	    Each held task counts once, even when one worker holds several.
146	    """
147	    return sum(
148	        1
149	        for step in run["steps"].values()
150	        if step.get("kind") != KIND_APPROVAL
151	        and step["status"] == STEP_RUNNING
152	        and step.get("lease_deadline") is not None
153	        and float(step["lease_deadline"]) > now
154	    )
155	
156	
157	def _promote_pending(run, now_iso):
158	    """Promote pending steps whose dependencies all succeeded.
159	
160	    Ordinary tasks become ``ready``; approval steps become ``waiting`` for a
161	    human decision.  Returns ``(ready_ids, waiting_ids)``.
162	    """
163	    index = run["order_index"]
164	    ready, waiting = [], []
165	    for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: index.get(s, 0)):
166	        step = run["steps"][sid]
167	        if step["status"] != STEP_PENDING:
168	            continue
169	        if all(run["steps"][d]["status"] == STEP_SUCCEEDED for d in step["depends_on"]):
170	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
171	                step["status"] = STEP_WAITING
172	                waiting.append(sid)
173	            else:
174	                step["status"], step["ready_at"] = STEP_READY, now_iso
175	                ready.append(sid)
176	    return ready, waiting
177	
178	
179	def _derive_run_status(run):
180	    """Derive the run status from its steps; stays ``pending`` until claimed."""
181	    steps = list(run["steps"].values())
182	    if any(s["status"] == STEP_FAILED for s in steps):
183	        return RUN_FAILED
184	    if steps and all(s["status"] == STEP_SUCCEEDED for s in steps):
185	        return RUN_SUCCEEDED
186	    if any(s["status"] in (STEP_RUNNING, STEP_SUCCEEDED) for s in steps):
187	        return RUN_RUNNING
188	    return RUN_PENDING

191	class Scheduler:
192	    """Coordinates workers against a :class:`WorkflowStore`."""
193	
194	    def __init__(self, store, clock=None, backoff_base=1.0, sleep=None):
195	        self.store = store
196	        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else store.now
197	        self.backoff_base = float(backoff_base)
198	        self._sleep = sleep if sleep is not None else _time.sleep
199	
200	    def now(self):
201	        return float(self._clock())
202	
203	    def _iso(self, when=None):
204	        return format_time(self.now() if when is None else when)
205	
206	    def _event(self, run, run_id, step_id, etype, attempt=None, worker_id=None, **extra):
207	        event = {"at": self._iso(), "run_id": run_id, "step_id": step_id, "type": etype,
208	                 "attempt": attempt, "worker_id": worker_id}
209	        event.update(extra)
210	        run["history"].append(event)
211	        return event
212	
213	    # -- workflow / run lifecycle --------------------------------------
214	    def submit(self, tenant, workflow_id, steps):
215	        return self.store.save_workflow(tenant, workflow_id, steps)
216	
217	    def start_run(self, tenant, workflow_id, run_id=None, params=None, max_parallelism=None,
218	                  idempotency_key=None, not_before=None):
219	        key = normalize_idempotency_key(idempotency_key)
220	        max_parallelism = normalize_max_parallelism(max_parallelism)
221	        if key is not None:
222	            params = normalize_params(params)
223	        not_before = normalize_not_before(not_before)
224	        with self.store.locked():
225	            if key is not None:
226	                return self._start_idempotent_run(
227	                    tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, max_parallelism, key, not_before
228	                )
229	            plan = self.store.get_workflow(tenant, workflow_id)
230	            run_id = run_id or self.store.generate_run_id()
231	            if self.store.run_exists(run_id) == tenant:
232	                raise WorkflowError("run already exists: %s" % run_id, "duplicate_run")
233	            run = new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, self._iso(),
234	                          max_parallelism=max_parallelism, not_before=not_before)
235	            return self._create_run(run, plan)
236	
237	    def _start_idempotent_run(self, tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, max_parallelism, key,
238	                              not_before):
239	        """Create once per (tenant, trimmed key); replay identical requests.
240	
241	        Runs inside the store lock so concurrent identical requests share one
242	        run while differing requests conflict against the first creation.
243	        """
244	        index = self.store.load_idempotency(tenant)
245	        record = index.get(key)
246	        if record is not None:
247	            existing = self.get_run(tenant, record["run_id"])
248	            if run_id is not None and run_id != existing["run_id"]:
249	                raise ConflictError(
250	                    "idempotency_key %s is already bound to run %s"
251	                    % (key, existing["run_id"]),
252	                    "idempotency_conflict",
253	                )
254	            if existing["workflow_id"] != workflow_id \
255	                    or not params_equal(existing.get("params") or {}, params) \
256	                    or existing.get("max_parallelism") != max_parallelism \
257	                    or existing.get("not_before") != not_before:
258	                raise ConflictError(
259	                    "request differs from the run first created with idempotency_key %s" % key,
260	                    "idempotency_conflict",
261	                )
262	            # A repeat changes nothing: no history, no updated_at, no lease.
263	            return existing
264	        plan = self.store.get_workflow(tenant, workflow_id)
265	        run_id = run_id or self.store.generate_run_id()
266	        if self.store.run_exists(run_id) == tenant:
267	            raise WorkflowError("run already exists: %s" % run_id, "duplicate_run")
268	        run = new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, self._iso(),
269	                      max_parallelism=max_parallelism, idempotency_key=key,
270	                      not_before=not_before)
271	        self._create_run(run, plan)
272	        index[key] = {"run_id": run_id}
273	        self.store.save_idempotency(tenant, index)
274	        return run
275	
276	    def _create_run(self, run, plan):
277	        """Append creation events and persist a freshly built run.
278	
279	        A run with a future ``not_before`` stays fully ``pending``: its root
280	        nodes are opened (one ``ready``/``waiting`` history event each) only
281	        when the first claim arrives at or after that time.  A past, present
282	        or missing start time opens the roots immediately, exactly like the
283	        legacy create behavior.
284	        """
285	        run_id = run["run_id"]
286	        self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_created")
287	        not_before = run.get("not_before")
288	        if not_before is None or float(not_before) <= self.now():
289	            self._open_root_nodes(run)
290	        run["status"], run["updated_at"] = _derive_run_status(run), self._iso()
291	        return self.store.save_run(run)
292	
293	    def _open_root_nodes(self, run, when=None):
294	        """Promote every pending node whose dependencies all succeeded.
295	
296	        Each promoted node records exactly one ``ready`` or ``waiting``
297	        history event, so calling this on repeated claims never re-opens a
298	        node.  Returns ``(ready_ids, waiting_ids)``.
299	        """
300	        now_iso = self._iso() if when is None else when
301	        ready, waiting = _promote_pending(run, now_iso)
302	        for sid in ready:
303	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "ready",
304	                        attempt=run["steps"][sid]["attempt"])
305	        for sid in waiting:
306	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "waiting", attempt=0)
307	        return ready, waiting
308	
309	    def get_run(self, tenant, run_id):
310	        run = self.store.load_run(tenant, run_id)
311	        if run["tenant"] != tenant:
312	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
313	        return run
314	
315	    def list_runs(self, tenant, status=None, limit=50, after=None):
316	        return self.store.list_runs(tenant, status=status, limit=limit, after=after)
317	
318	    def history(self, run_id, tenant=None):
319	        if tenant is None:
320	            tenant = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
321	            if tenant is None:
322	                raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
323	        return list(self.get_run(tenant, run_id)["history"])
324	
325	    # -- lease expiry --------------------------------------------------
326	    def _expire_leases(self, run, now):
327	        """Release leases past their deadline; each one records a takeover."""
328	        reclaimed = []
329	        for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: run["order_index"].get(s, 0)):
330	            step = run["steps"][sid]
331	            if step["status"] != STEP_RUNNING:
332	                continue
333	            if step.get("lease_deadline") is None or float(step["lease_deadline"]) > now:
334	                continue
335	            holder = step["worker_id"]
336	            step.update(status=STEP_READY, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None, ready_at=self._iso())
337	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "takeover", attempt=step["attempt"], worker_id=holder)
338	            reclaimed.append(sid)
339	        return reclaimed
340	
341	    # -- claim / complete / fail ---------------------------------------
342	    def claim(self, tenant, run_id, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
343	        """Lease the next ready step, or return ``None`` when none is ready.
344	
345	        A delayed run (a future ``not_before``) cannot be activated early:
346	        claims before the start time return ``None`` without touching its
347	        state, history or ``updated_at``.  The first claim at or after the
348	        start time opens the root nodes (one ``ready``/``waiting`` event each)
349	        and then leases at most one task under the usual order and quota; a
350	        run whose roots are all approvals activates and still returns ``None``.
351	        """
352	        if not isinstance(worker_id, str) or not worker_id.strip():
353	            raise WorkflowError("worker_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_worker")
354	        if not isinstance(lease_seconds, (int, float)) or isinstance(lease_seconds, bool) \
355	                or lease_seconds <= 0:
356	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
357	        now = self.now()
358	        with self.store.locked():
359	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
360	            not_before = run.get("not_before")
361	            if not_before is not None and float(not_before) > now:
362	                # Still sleeping: activation happens only via a due claim.
363	                return None
364	            self._expire_leases(run, now)
365	            self._open_root_nodes(run)
366	            candidates = [s for s in run["steps"].values() if s["status"] == STEP_READY]
367	            index = run["order_index"]
368	            quota = run.get("max_parallelism")
369	            at_quota = quota is not None and _active_lease_count(run, now) >= int(quota)
370	            step = (min(candidates, key=lambda s: (index.get(s["id"], 0), s["id"]))
371	                    if candidates and not at_quota else None)
372	            previous = run["status"]
373	            if step is not None:
374	                step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=worker_id, next_attempt_at=None,
375	                            lease_deadline=now + float(lease_seconds), started_at=self._iso())
376	                self._event(run, run_id, step["id"], "claim", attempt=step["attempt"],
377	                            worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=step["lease_deadline"])
378	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
379	            if step is not None and run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and previous == RUN_PENDING:
380	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_started")
381	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
382	            self.store.save_run(run)
383	            return dict(step) if step is not None else None
384	
385	    def heartbeat(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
386	        """Renew the lease on a running step held by ``worker_id``.
387	
388	        The new deadline is the later of the current one and
389	        ``now + lease_seconds``; only the deadline and ``updated_at`` change.
390	        A renewal that would not extend the deadline returns the run
391	        unchanged and appends no history.
392	        """
393	        if not isinstance(worker_id, str) or not worker_id.strip():
394	            raise WorkflowError("worker_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_worker")
395	        if not isinstance(step_id, str) or not step_id.strip():
396	            raise WorkflowError("step_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_step")
397	        if not isinstance(lease_seconds, (int, float)) or isinstance(lease_seconds, bool) \
398	                or not math.isfinite(lease_seconds) or lease_seconds <= 0:
399	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
400	        now = self.now()
401	        with self.store.locked():
402	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
403	            if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
404	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
405	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
406	            if run["status"] in (RUN_SUCCEEDED, RUN_FAILED):
407	                raise ConflictError("run %s is already %s" % (run_id, run["status"]),
408	                                    "run_finished")
409	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
410	            if step is None:
411	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
412	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
413	                raise ConflictError(
414	                    "step %s is an approval node; use /decision" % step_id, "not_a_task"
415	                )
416	            if step["status"] != STEP_RUNNING:
417	                raise LeaseError("step %s is not running" % step_id, "lease_not_held")
418	            if step["worker_id"] != worker_id:
419	                raise LeaseError("step %s lease is not held by worker %s" % (step_id, worker_id))
420	            deadline = float(step["lease_deadline"])
421	            if now >= deadline:
422	                raise LeaseError("lease for step %s expired" % step_id, "lease_expired")
423	            new_deadline = max(deadline, now + float(lease_seconds))
424	            if new_deadline <= deadline:
425	                return run
426	            step["lease_deadline"] = new_deadline
427	            self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "heartbeat", attempt=step["attempt"],
428	                        worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=new_deadline)
429	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
430	            self.store.save_run(run)
431	            return run
432	
433	    def _require_lease(self, run, step_id, worker_id):
434	        step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
435	        if step is None:
436	            raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
437	        if step["status"] == STEP_RUNNING and step["worker_id"] == worker_id:
438	            return step
439	        raise LeaseError("step %s lease is not held by worker %s" % (step_id, worker_id))
440	
441	    def complete(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, worker_id, result=None):
442	        """Idempotent: repeating the same complete is a no-op."""
443	        now = self.now()
444	        with self.store.locked():
445	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
446	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
447	            if step is None:
448	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
449	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
450	                raise ConflictError(
451	                    "step %s is an approval node; use /decision" % step_id, "not_a_task"
452	                )
453	            if step["status"] == STEP_SUCCEEDED and step["worker_id"] == worker_id:
454	                return run
455	            step = self._require_lease(run, step_id, worker_id)
456	            if float(step["lease_deadline"]) <= now:
457	                raise LeaseError("lease for step %s expired" % step_id, "lease_expired")
458	            step.update(attempt=step["attempt"] + 1, status=STEP_SUCCEEDED, result=result,
459	                        error=None, finished_at=self._iso(), lease_deadline=None)
460	            self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "complete", attempt=step["attempt"],
461	                        worker_id=worker_id, result=result)
462	            self._open_root_nodes(run)
463	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
464	            if run["status"] == RUN_SUCCEEDED:
465	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_succeeded")
466	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
467	            self.store.save_run(run)
468	            return run
469	
470	    def fail(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, worker_id, error=None):
471	        """Count the attempt, retry with backoff, or fail the step and run."""
472	        now = self.now()
473	        with self.store.locked():
474	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
475	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
476	            if step is None:
477	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
478	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
479	                raise ConflictError(
480	                    "step %s is an approval node; use /decision" % step_id, "not_a_task"
481	                )
482	            step = self._require_lease(run, step_id, worker_id)
483	            step.update(attempt=step["attempt"] + 1, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None, error=error)
484	            self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "fail", attempt=step["attempt"], worker_id=worker_id,
485	                        error=error)
486	            if step["attempt"] >= int(step["max_attempts"]):
487	                step.update(status=STEP_FAILED, finished_at=self._iso(), next_attempt_at=None)
488	                self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "attempts_exhausted", attempt=step["attempt"],
489	                            worker_id=worker_id)
490	            else:
491	                step.update(status=STEP_READY, ready_at=self._iso(),
492	                            next_attempt_at=self._iso(now + backoff_seconds(
493	                                step["attempt"], self.backoff_base)))
494	                self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "retry", attempt=step["attempt"],
495	                            worker_id=worker_id)
496	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
497	            if run["status"] == RUN_FAILED:
498	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_failed")
499	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
500	            self.store.save_run(run)
501	            return run
502	
503	    # -- human decisions -----------------------------------------------
504	    def decide(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, actor, decision):
505	        """Record a human approve/reject decision for an approval step.
506	
507	        Repeating the *same* decision from the *same* actor is idempotent and
508	        returns the unchanged run; a different actor or the opposite decision
509	        conflicts with the recorded decision.
510	        """
511	        if not isinstance(actor, str) or not actor.strip():
512	            raise WorkflowError("actor must be a non-empty string", "bad_actor")
513	        actor = actor.strip()
514	        if decision not in ("approve", "reject"):
515	            raise WorkflowError("decision must be 'approve' or 'reject'", "bad_decision")
516	        with self.store.locked():
517	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
518	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
519	            if step is None:
520	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
521	            if step.get("kind") != KIND_APPROVAL:
522	                raise ConflictError("step %s is not an approval node" % step_id, "not_an_approval")
523	            recorded = step.get("approval")
524	            if recorded is not None:
525	                if recorded["actor"] == actor and recorded["decision"] == decision:
526	                    return run
527	                raise ConflictError(
528	                    "step %s already decided by %s: %s"
529	                    % (step_id, recorded["actor"], recorded["decision"]),
530	                    "already_decided",
531	                )
532	            if step["status"] != STEP_WAITING:
533	                raise ConflictError(
534	                    "step %s is not waiting for a decision" % step_id, "not_waiting"
535	                )
536	            event = self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "decision", attempt=0, worker_id=None,
537	                                actor=actor, decision=decision)
538	            at = event["at"]
539	            step["approval"] = {"actor": actor, "decision": decision, "at": at}
540	            previous = run["status"]
541	            if decision == "approve":
542	                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED, finished_at=at)
543	                self._open_root_nodes(run, at)
544	                run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
545	            else:
546	                step.update(status=STEP_FAILED, finished_at=at)
547	                run["status"] = RUN_FAILED
548	            if run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and previous == RUN_PENDING:
549	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_started")
550	            if run["status"] == RUN_SUCCEEDED:
551	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_succeeded")
552	            elif run["status"] == RUN_FAILED:
553	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_failed")
554	            run["updated_at"] = at
555	            self.store.save_run(run)
556	            return run
557	
558	    # -- history / replay ----------------------------------------------
559	    def replay(self, tenant, run_id):
560	        """Rebuild run state from the append-only history."""
561	        stored = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
562	        plan = self.store.get_workflow(tenant, stored["workflow_id"])
563	        rebuilt = new_run(tenant, stored["workflow_id"], run_id, stored.get("params"), plan,
564	                          stored["created_at"],
565	                          max_parallelism=stored.get("max_parallelism"),
566	                          idempotency_key=stored.get("idempotency_key"),
567	                          not_before=stored.get("not_before"))
568	        steps = rebuilt["steps"]
569	        for event in stored["history"]:
570	            sid, etype, at = event.get("step_id"), event.get("type"), event.get("at")
571	            attempt = event.get("attempt")
572	            if sid is None:
573	                if etype == "run_succeeded":
574	                    rebuilt["status"] = RUN_SUCCEEDED
575	                elif etype == "run_failed":
576	                    rebuilt["status"] = RUN_FAILED
577	                elif etype == "run_started" and rebuilt["status"] == RUN_PENDING:
578	                    rebuilt["status"] = RUN_RUNNING
579	                continue
580	            step = steps.get(sid)
581	            if step is None:
582	                continue
583	            if etype == "ready":
584	                step.update(status=STEP_READY, ready_at=at)
585	            elif etype == "waiting":
586	                step.update(status=STEP_WAITING)
587	            elif etype == "claim":
588	                step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=event.get("worker_id"),
589	                            started_at=at, lease_deadline=event.get("lease_deadline"))
590	            elif etype == "heartbeat":
591	                step["lease_deadline"] = event.get("lease_deadline")
592	            elif etype == "takeover":
593	                step.update(status=STEP_READY, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None)
594	            elif etype == "complete":
595	                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED, result=event.get("result"), finished_at=at,
596	                            lease_deadline=None, worker_id=None,
597	                            attempt=step["attempt"] if attempt is None else attempt)
598	            elif etype == "decision":
599	                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED if event.get("decision") == "approve"
600	                            else STEP_FAILED, finished_at=at,
601	                            approval={"actor": event.get("actor"),
602	                                      "decision": event.get("decision"), "at": at})
603	            elif etype == "fail":
604	                step.update(error=event.get("error"), worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
605	                            attempt=step["attempt"] if attempt is None else attempt)
606	            elif etype == "retry":
607	                step["status"] = STEP_READY
608	            elif etype == "attempts_exhausted":
609	                step.update(status=STEP_FAILED, finished_at=at)
610	        if all(s["status"] == STEP_SUCCEEDED for s in steps.values()):
611	            rebuilt["status"] = RUN_SUCCEEDED
612	        elif any(s["status"] == STEP_FAILED for s in steps.values()):
613	            rebuilt["status"] = RUN_FAILED
614	        return rebuilt

"""Command line interface: ``python3 -m flowd [--data-dir DIR] <command>``.

Every command prints a single line of JSON to stdout.  Failures print a
single line of JSON to stderr and exit with a non-zero status.
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .http_app import _run_view, create_server
from .model import WorkflowError
from .scheduler import Scheduler
from .store import WorkflowStore

DEFAULT_DATA_DIR = "./flowd_data"


def emit(payload):
    """Print one line of JSON to stdout."""
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()


def fail(message):
    """Print one line of JSON to stderr and return a non-zero exit code."""
    sys.stderr.write(json.dumps({"error": message}, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    sys.stderr.flush()
    return 1


def _step_args(parser, claim=False):
    """Shared arguments for the claim/complete/fail subcommands."""
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", required=True, dest="run_id")
    parser.add_argument("--tenant", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--worker", required=True)
    if claim:
        parser.add_argument("--lease-seconds", type=float, default=30.0, dest="lease_seconds")
    else:
        parser.add_argument("--step", required=True)
    return parser


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="flowd",
                                     description="distributed workflow orchestration backend")
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", default=DEFAULT_DATA_DIR,
                        help="storage root (default: %(default)s)")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    serve = sub.add_parser("serve", help="run the HTTP API")
    serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)

    submit = sub.add_parser("submit", help="validate and store a workflow DAG")
    submit.add_argument("--tenant", required=True)
    submit.add_argument("--workflow", required=True)
    submit.add_argument("--file", required=True, help="JSON file holding a list of steps")

    status = sub.add_parser("status", help="show one run")
    status.add_argument("--run-id", required=True, dest="run_id")
    status.add_argument("--tenant", required=True)

    _step_args(sub.add_parser("claim", help="claim the next ready step"), claim=True)
    complete = _step_args(sub.add_parser("complete", help="complete a claimed step"))
    complete.add_argument("--result", help="optional JSON result")
    failure = _step_args(sub.add_parser("fail", help="fail a step (retry or exhaust attempts)"))
    failure.add_argument("--error", default="step failed")

    listing = sub.add_parser("list", help="list runs of a tenant")
    listing.add_argument("--tenant", required=True)
    listing.add_argument("--status")
    listing.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=50)
    return parser


def _load_steps(path):
    """Read a steps file: a JSON list, or an object with a ``steps`` list."""
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            payload = json.load(handle)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise WorkflowError("cannot read steps file: %s" % exc, "bad_file")
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise WorkflowError("steps file is not valid JSON: %s" % exc, "bad_json")
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        payload = payload.get("steps")
    if not isinstance(payload, list):
        raise WorkflowError("steps file must contain a JSON list of steps", "bad_file")
    return payload


def _serve(store, scheduler, args):
    server = create_server(store, args.host, args.port, scheduler)
    emit({"ok": True, "host": args.host, "port": int(args.port), "data_dir": store.root})
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
    return 0


def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        store = WorkflowStore(args.data_dir)
        scheduler = Scheduler(store)
        if args.command == "serve":
            return _serve(store, scheduler, args)
        if args.command == "submit":
            plan = scheduler.submit(args.tenant, args.workflow, _load_steps(args.file))
            emit({"tenant": args.tenant, "workflow_id": plan["workflow_id"], "order": plan["order"]})
            return 0
        if args.command == "status":
            emit(_run_view(scheduler.get_run(args.tenant, args.run_id)))
            return 0
        if args.command == "claim":
            step = scheduler.claim(args.tenant, args.run_id, args.worker, args.lease_seconds)
            emit({"run_id": args.run_id, "step": step and {"id": step["id"],
                                                           "status": step["status"],
                                                           "attempt": step["attempt"]}})
            return 0
        if args.command == "complete":
            run = scheduler.complete(args.tenant, args.run_id, args.step, args.worker,
                                     json.loads(args.result) if args.result else None)
            emit({"run_id": run["run_id"], "status": run["status"]})
            return 0
        if args.command == "fail":
            run = scheduler.fail(args.tenant, args.run_id, args.step, args.worker, args.error)
            step = run["steps"][args.step]
            emit({"run_id": run["run_id"], "status": run["status"],
                  "step": {"id": args.step, "status": step["status"], "attempt": step["attempt"],
                           "next_attempt_at": step["next_attempt_at"]}})
            return 0
        if args.command == "list":
            items, next_after = scheduler.list_runs(args.tenant, args.status, args.limit)
            emit({"tenant": args.tenant, "next_after": next_after,
                  "items": [{"run_id": r["run_id"], "status": r["status"]} for r in items]})
            return 0
        return fail("unknown command: %s" % args.command)
    except WorkflowError as exc:
        return fail(exc.message)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return fail("invalid JSON argument: %s" % exc)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
        return fail("internal error: %s" % exc)

    sys.exit(main())

"""End-to-end tests for the stdlib HTTP API."""

import json
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

from flowd.http_app import create_server
from flowd.store import WorkflowStore

LINEAR = [
    {"id": "step1", "depends_on": []},
    {"id": "step2", "depends_on": ["step1"]},
    {"id": "step3", "depends_on": ["step2"]},
]


class HttpTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="flowd-http-")
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.root, True)
        self.server = create_server(WorkflowStore(self.root), "127.0.0.1", 0)
        self.port = self.server.server_address[1]
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        self.addCleanup(self.server.server_close)
        self.addCleanup(self.server.shutdown)

    def call(self, method, path, body=None, raw_body=None):
        """Return (status, parsed json or None); never raises on HTTP errors."""
        data = raw_body
        if body is not None:
            data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:%d%s" % (self.port, path),
                                        data=data, method=method)
        if data is not None:
            request.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
                payload = response.read()
                return response.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            payload = exc.read()
            return exc.code, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)

    def submit_workflow(self, tenant="acme", workflow_id="etl", steps=None):
        status, body = self.call("POST", "/v1/workflows",
                                 {"tenant": tenant, "workflow_id": workflow_id,
                                  "steps": LINEAR if steps is None else steps})
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        return body

        payload = {"tenant": tenant, "workflow_id": workflow_id}

            payload["run_id"] = run_id
        status, body = self.call("POST", "/v1/runs", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        return body

    def claim(self, run_id="r1", tenant="acme", worker="w1", lease=60):
        return self.call("POST", "/v1/runs/%s/claim" % run_id,
                         {"tenant": tenant, "worker_id": worker, "lease_seconds": lease})

    def complete(self, step_id, run_id="r1", tenant="acme", worker="w1"):
        return self.call("POST", "/v1/runs/%s/complete" % run_id,
                         {"tenant": tenant, "step_id": step_id, "worker_id": worker})

    def drive(self, run_id="r1"):
        """Claim/complete the whole linear DAG over HTTP."""
        body = None
        for expected in ("step1", "step2", "step3"):
            status, body = self.claim(run_id)
            self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
            self.assertEqual(body["step"]["id"], expected)
            status, body = self.complete(expected, run_id)
            self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        return body

        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET", "/healthz"), (200, {"ok": True}))

        status, body = self.call("POST", "/v1/workflows", raw_body=b"{not json")

    def test_run_lifecycle_over_http(self):
        self.submit_workflow()

        self.assertEqual(run["status"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in run["steps"]], ["ready", "pending", "pending"])

        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(body["status"], "succeeded")
        self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in body["steps"]], ["succeeded"] * 3)

        self.submit_workflow()

        self.assertEqual(self.claim(), (204, None))

        status, body = self.call("POST", "/v1/runs/r2/fail",
                                 {"tenant": "acme", "step_id": "s", "worker_id": "w1",
                                  "error": "boom"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        step = body["steps"][0]
        self.assertEqual((step["status"], step["attempt"]), ("ready", 1))
        self.assertIsNotNone(step["next_attempt_at"])
        self.claim("r2")
        status, body = self.call("POST", "/v1/runs/r2/fail",
                                 {"tenant": "acme", "step_id": "s", "worker_id": "w1",
                                  "error": "boom again"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(body["status"], "failed")

        self.assertEqual((status, body["items"]), (200, []))

    def test_listing_with_status_filter_and_limit(self):

        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET", "/v1/runs?tenant=acme&status=succeeded")[1]["items"], [])
        self.assertEqual(

        status, body = self.call("GET", "/v1/runs?tenant=")

33	python3 -m flowd --data-dir ./flowd_data claim --run-id run-abc --tenant acme --worker w1
34	python3 -m flowd --data-dir ./flowd_data complete --run-id run-abc --step step1 --tenant acme --worker w1
35	python3 -m flowd --data-dir ./flowd_data fail --run-id run-abc --step step1 --tenant acme --worker w1 --error boom
